name: 3: 42-day QP reached; retain earnings
description:
Creates a 2-year apprenticeship (730-day planned duration, qualifying period = 42 days), approves it, then records a completion after 60 days in learning. Because 60 > 42, the qualifying period is met — earnings should be retained regardless. Completion always retains full earnings.

Earnings are not subject to Qualifying Periods for Completion. Completion payment is still payable, along with a Balancing payment to roll-up the remaining earnings.

steps.name: SLD Records Completion (2 months in learning — above 42-day qualifying period)
